caption_en: Reactor hall at the existing Dukovany Nuclear Power Plant, Czech Republic, 6 November 2012. Photo: Petr Pavlicek / IAEA, IAEA Imagebank, CC BY-SA 2.0. Used unchanged as an industry illustration; it does not show the later Dukovany new-build project.
alt_en: Real photograph inside the reactor hall at the existing Dukovany Nuclear Power Plant in 2012, showing service platforms, an overhead crane, industrial equipment and a worker in yellow clothing.
